# Population Health Modelling Consensus Reporting Network for Noncommunicable Diseases (POPCORN-NCD)

**Developing an internationally agreed-upon reporting guideline for studies that model noncommunicable diseases.**
:::

We're developing POPCORN, a new reporting guideline to improve the consistency and transparency of research using simulation models that address noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) like heart disease, cancer, and diabetes. Following the [EQUATOR](https://www.equator-network.org) methods, will provide standardised guidance to help researchers report their models transparently, enabling policymakers and the public to better understand and trust model-based evidence ([EQUATOR registration](https://www.equator-network.org/library/reporting-guidelines-under-development/reporting-guidelines-under-development-for-other-study-designs/#NCD)).
